title: Act: Add secret door and dust sources, register room sources and run art:generate
summary: New sceneExtras sources, ART_SOURCES registration, regenerated PNGs and manifest
description: Create secret-door and dust grids with draw.ts helpers, add ROOM_SOURCES and the extras to ART_SOURCES, then run the generator so PNGs and manifest entries are committed.
acceptance_criteria: ART_SOURCES contains room, boy, extras and cursor sources
npm run art:generate completes and writes room/*.png, secret-door and dust PNGs

preserve: Existing manifest entries not produced by sources until Act A2

steps.action: Create the file. Import createGrid, fillRect, outlineRect, shadeRect, rampIndex from './draw' and type ArtSource from './sources'. secretDoorGrid returns a 32x64 Grid: shadeRect indigo interior, outlineRect brass frame, fillRect a lamp-ramp strip on the bottom row. dustGrid returns a 4x4 Grid of moon ramp step 4 with transparent corners (index 0). Export SCENE_EXTRA_SOURCES with ids 'objects/secret-door-open' (path worlds/the-boys-room/objects/secret-door-open.png) and 'effect:dust' (path worlds/the-boys-room/effects/dust.png).
steps.expected: The module exports two single-frame sources of 32x64 and 4x4

steps.action: Add imports of ROOM_SOURCES from './roomSources' and SCENE_EXTRA_SOURCES from './sceneExtras'. Change the ART_SOURCES array to spread them after BOY_SOURCES. Make the ArtSource import in roomBackground/roomFurniture stay type-only to avoid a runtime cycle.
From game/frontend run the generator so every source is written as a PNG and merged into manifest.json (existing ids replaced in place, new ids appended).
steps.expected: room/*.png, secret-door-open.png and dust.png exist and manifest.json contains the room/* ids
